title: Signals beamed into Benowitz's computer from across the street

tellings.quote: Yes, maybe that happened. I mean that's I the person that told me that was was was Bill.

plain: Greg Bishop, a writer on UFO history, told Jesse Michels about a man named Benowitz in Albuquerque, New Mexico, in the early 1980s, near Sandia National Laboratories, a government research lab. Bishop says UFO researcher Bill Moore told him that signals were beamed into Benowitz's computer from across the street. If true, it would mean someone was deliberately feeding Benowitz information, and Bishop allows that maybe it happened.
